lines.text: Let us practise some easier ones.
Read the cursive word. Tap the printed word that matches.
Spell duck. Trace each letter of duck.
Spell horse. Look at it and remember it.
Spell snake. Trace each letter of snake.
Spell sun. Trace each letter of sun.
Trace the letter X. X is for xylophone.
Try to stay on the dots. Tap the drop to start over.
Try to stay on the line. Tap the drop to start over.
Write neighbor. My neighbor waved. neighbor.
Write telephone. The telephone rang. telephone.
Write the short form of Mister.
Write the word that means: The usual weather of a place over many years.
Write this sentence. If you can't come, that's fine.
